facts.text: Tim has been reading J.K. Rowling's works for a long time.

evidence.quote: I've been reading her stuff for a long time. Her stories have been with me and still inspire me.

facts.text: Tim finds J.K. Rowling's writing to be inspiring and impactful on his own creative process.

evidence.quote: J.K. Rowling is such an inspiring writer. Her books are so captivating with their detail and creative storytelling. I'm always taking notes on her style for my own writing.
Certain authors are like goldmines of inspiration for me.

facts.text: Tim references a specific quote by J.K. Rowling that he finds meaningful: 'Turn on the light - happiness hides in the darkest of times.'

evidence.quote: There's a quote by J.K. Rowling that I really like: 'Turn on the light - happiness hides in the darkest of times.'
